term: commission report resting on the testimony of those present (Testimony.RestsOnTestimonyOfThosePresent)
definition: `RestsOnTestimonyOfThosePresent r`: the commission report r goes back, through its transmission, to the testimony of disciples present when the commission was given. Example: a report transmitted from one of the eleven of Matthew 28.16. Counterexample: a saying formed in a later community and attributed to the risen Jesus. It does not by itself say that the testimony is accurate; that is STMT-TESTIMONY-OF-THOSE-PRESENT-IS-ACCURATE.
